title: ipomoea orizabensis subsp. novogaliciana
intro: Ipomoea orizabensis subsp. novogaliciana, commonly known as the Novogaliciana morning glory, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Convolvulaceae family. It is a perennial vine native to Mexico, known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Ipomoea orizabensis subsp. novogaliciana include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic agent, which can help to alleviate conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
